title: PushSubscription/get: reject invalid properties with invalidArguments
description: RFC 8620 §5.1 (rfc8620.txt:1609-1611): "If an invalid property is requested, the call MUST be rejected with an \"invalidArguments\" error." §7.2.1 inherits §5.1. crate-jmap-server/src/push.rs handle_push_subscription_get (bd:JMAP-nbk3.2) only rejects url/keys (forbidden) and silently drops unknown names. The generic layer cannot know extension properties (chatPush, draft-atwood-jmap-chat-push-00), so the fix needs a way for the backend to name its valid extension properties (or a fixed RFC set plus a backend hook). Generic handle_get likewise delegates this to the backend.
